v1.1.1.title: Opening Mergio again works
v1.1.1.text: Clicking the Mergio icon while it was already running did nothing. Now it opens the control panel of the copy that is running.

v1.1.0.title: Installers for every system
v1.1.0.text: A Windows installer, a macOS disk image and Linux packages, so Mergio installs like any other app.

v1.1.0.title: A new name: Mergio
v1.1.0.text: The app got its final name and logo.

v1.1.0.title: Getting-started tour
v1.1.0.text: The first time you open Mergio, a short tour shows how to connect your chats, style the overlay and add it to OBS.

v1.1.0.title: Complete setup guide
v1.1.0.text: The guide on GitHub walks through installing, connecting every platform and adding the overlay to OBS, step by step.

v1.0.0.title: Every live chat in one overlay
v1.0.0.text: Chats from YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok and Facebook, merged into a single OBS browser source.

v1.0.0.title: A control panel
v1.0.0.text: Add your chats, choose a style and send test messages from a control panel in your browser.

v1.0.0.title: One small app
v1.0.0.text: A single-file app that runs quietly in the background, with nothing else to install.

notes.title: Twitch reconnects properly
notes.text: After a dropped connection, Twitch no longer stays on *Connecting* and keeps its viewer count.

notes.title: Key fields that do what you expect
notes.text: Click a saved key and type or paste a new one: it replaces the old key. Saving now tells you whether a key was saved, removed or left unchanged.

notes.title: Safer settings
notes.text: Numbers, choices, colours and fonts are checked when you save, so a typo or an edited `config.json` can't break the overlay.

notes.title: Alerts follow your filters
notes.text: Blocked words and *Hide shared chat* now apply to the alerts overlay too.

notes.title: Follower goals recover by themselves
notes.text: A lookup error disappears as soon as the next lookup works.

notes.title: No old alerts when TikTok connects
notes.text: Follows, shares and subscriptions from before the LIVE connected no longer pop up as new.

notes.title: Ready for very long streams
notes.text: TikTok gift combos and Facebook comment history no longer keep growing.

notes.title: Live chat fits every window
notes.text: The list fills the space below the filters, also in narrow OBS docks, so the newest message is always in view. Alerts no longer repeat their amount, and dark name colours are lightened so you can read them.

notes.title: Small fixes in the control panel
notes.text: The *Live preview* title isn't cut off on mid-size windows, hiding the preview is only remembered when you do it, the *Use Mergio as an app* steps sit under its description, and the Help page answers viewer count and follower goal questions. The overlays have an icon and OBS logs no longer show a missing `favicon.ico`.

notes.title: More private follower lookups
notes.text: The hidden browser that reads TikTok and Facebook follower counts keeps its profile in Mergio's own data folder, which only you can open, instead of the shared temp folder.

notes.title: Reporting a security problem
notes.text: now goes to GitHub's private reporting. See the security policy.

notes.title: Viewer count overlay
notes.text: A new overlay at `http://localhost:8787/viewers` adds up everyone watching on every platform, live, in five styles. Set it up on the new *Viewer count* page.

notes.title: Follower goals overlay
notes.text: `http://localhost:8787/followers` shows each platform's followers with a goal and a progress bar that celebrates when you reach it. The next goal appears by itself, or you can set your own. Set it up on the new *Follower goals* page.

notes.title: All in one line
notes.text: Both counters can sit in a single row that shrinks to fit any browser source.

notes.title: Every language looks right
notes.text: Names and messages in Arabic, Hebrew and other right-to-left scripts keep their direction, default profile pictures show the first letter of any script, and alert names in joined scripts like Sinhala and Arabic animate as whole words. *Send test* now includes messages in other languages too.

notes.title: Neater chat and Live chat
notes.text: The profile picture has its own column, so long messages stay lined up, and the *Live chat* page now looks like the overlay. You can filter it by platform.

notes.title: A control panel for every screen
notes.text: It fits any window size, the sidebar shrinks to icons, every setting has its own row with an icon, and settings sections start folded. The header button takes you straight to *Add to OBS*.

notes.title: A new installer look
notes.text: The Windows installer is dark and guides you through each step.

notes.title: Safer by design
notes.text: Other websites can't reach Mergio's local server or its live connection, saved keys never go back to the control panel or the overlays, and tokens are kept out of the log. Your settings can only be read by you, and updates only install when their checksum matches the one GitHub publishes. The security policy has the full list.

notes.title: Facebook setup, step by step with pictures
notes.text: Settings → Accounts & keys → **Show me how** opens a short guide that shows each Facebook screen with the button to press highlighted. It opens the right Facebook page for you and has copy buttons for anything you type. You'll find it on the Help page and the Chats page too.

notes.title: Mergio checks your Facebook token
notes.text: Paste the token in the last step and Mergio tells you in plain words whether it's the right one: your Page's token, your personal token (one more step), a token missing a permission, or not a token at all. A good token is saved right away.

notes.title: Messages line up with the name
notes.text: With the *Name on top* layout, a message now starts right after the profile picture: under the badges on Twitch, and under the name everywhere else. Wrapped alert text and follow-up messages line up the same way.

notes.title: Release notes show up reliably after an update
notes.text: The *What's new* popup now waits a moment for the notes when Mergio has just restarted, instead of saying they couldn't be loaded.

notes.title: See what's new after every update
notes.text: The first time you open the control panel on a new version, a popup shows that version's release notes, however you installed it. It shows once per version, and if an even newer version is already out, the update popup follows.

notes.title: Facebook token guide built in
notes.text: Settings → Accounts & keys now has step-by-step instructions right under the Facebook Page token field: create a free app, turn on the permissions, and get a Page token that doesn't expire. The same guide is on the Help page.

notes.title: Fixed Facebook setup steps
notes.text: The old steps skipped creating the app, so Facebook didn't offer the permissions Mergio needs. The guide, Help page and README now walk through the steps that work.

notes.title: Mergio updates itself
notes.text: Every time it opens, Mergio checks for a new version and shows a popup with everything that's new since yours. On the installed Windows app, **Download and install** downloads the update with a progress bar, installs it and opens Mergio again by itself. You can choose *Not now*; an *Update* pill under the logo keeps it one click away.

notes.title: Redesigned alert styles
notes.text: All six styles are rebuilt to look like polished stream overlays: Spotlight centres the picture with a light circling it and the name rising in, Banner is a TV-style lower third that wipes in, Neon draws its glowing tube before lighting up, Bubbly is a sticker that slaps on, Card is frosted glass that tilts into place, and Minimal is a black pill that grows open. No more confetti or clutter.

notes.title: Smooth control panel
notes.text: An animated opening with the Mergio logo drawing itself, soft transitions between pages, cards that rise in one after another, a sidebar highlight that glides to the page you pick, and springier notifications. All of it turns off if your system asks for reduced motion.

notes.title: Fresh style previews
notes.text: The style tiles on the *Alerts* page now play each new entrance.

notes.title: TikTok likes look like normal messages
notes.text: "liked the LIVE" is now a regular message from that viewer, with their picture and name, a red-pink glow and a beating heart, instead of a small pill. The ×count keeps going up in place while they keep tapping.

notes.title: Six alert styles
notes.text: The alerts overlay now has **Spotlight** (the new default: the gift or picture big, with spinning light rays, pulsing rings and a confetti shower), **Banner**, **Neon**, **Bubbly**, **Card** and **Minimal**. Pick one on the *Alerts* page from tiles that play a little preview; clicking a tile sends a test alert so you can see it move. Names animate in letter by letter, and a thin bar shows how long each alert stays.

notes.title: Optional alert chime
notes.text: A short sound with each alert, made by Mergio itself (no sound files), with its own volume.

notes.title: Name on top, messages below
notes.text: *Style → Layout* lets you choose between one line ("Name: message") and the name on its own line with the message underneath.

notes.title: One box per person
notes.text: When someone sends several messages in a row, *Style → Grouped messages go in* can put them **in the same box, one per line**, or in their own boxes under the picture as before.

notes.title: Friendlier settings
notes.text: Dropdowns now match the app (with keyboard support), short choices are simple buttons, sliders show a filled track, and the settings that confuse people have a small **ⓘ** with a plain-words explanation. The Style page has a short tip for first-timers and tidier sections.

notes.title: Facebook finds your live video by itself
notes.text: Add your Facebook Page once (`facebook.com/yourpage`) and Mergio connects to the comments every time you go live, then goes back to waiting when the stream ends. No more pasting a new link each stream.

notes.title: Follow-up messages tucked under the picture
notes.text: When someone sends several messages in a row, only the first shows their icon, picture and name. The rest get their own small bubble that starts under the picture.

notes.title: Turn the box behind messages off completely
notes.text: *Style → Box behind each message* now really removes the box, including the border and glow from the Glass, Neon and Retro looks, for plain text on your stream. The box settings hide while it's off.

notes.title: The alerts overlay is easy to find
notes.text: *Add to OBS* shows the Chat overlay and the Alerts overlay side by side, each with its link, size and live status. If the alerts overlay is off, you can turn it on right there. Home shows an Alerts overlay tile too.

notes.title: Separate alerts overlay
notes.text: Subs, gifts, Super Chats, follows and raids can show on their own browser source (`/alerts`) that you can place anywhere on your scene, one big animated alert at a time. On the **Alerts** page, choose whether alerts show *in the chat*, *on their own overlay* or *both*.

notes.title: Calmer alerts in the chat
notes.text: Alerts in the chat are now a normal chat line with the gift picture and a thin coloured edge. The big highlighted cards are still available under *Style → Alert look*.

notes.title: The real picture for every gift
notes.text: A Rose shows a rose and a Galaxy shows the galaxy. Kick's KICKs gifts show their own pictures too.

notes.title: Profile pictures for everyone in chat
notes.text: , even in very busy chats.

notes.title: Disappearing messages switch
notes.text: Messages can fade out after the time you choose, so only the newest stay on screen.

notes.title: Install the control panel as an app
notes.text: Click *Install app* (or the install icon in Chrome, Edge or Brave) to open Mergio in its own window instead of a browser tab.
The control panel shows when the alerts overlay is in OBS, and all open control panels stay in sync.
